procedural_matters: HUN 37 (Bow 11) was represented by Balazs Tomai.
Race Committee was represented by David Rollinson (Deputy Race Officer).
David Rollinson (Deputy Race Officer) provided video evidence.
facts: In race 3 black flag was displayed as the preparatory signal.
Just before the start, the race committee identified HUN 37's (Bow 11) hull in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
HUN 37 was scored BFD in race 3.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
